capabilities: Caption images after the embed bar as figure captions
Lay out images on one line as an equal-cell row
Place an image beside text with an [!aside] callout
Apply the same layouts and captions to videos
extras: Degrades gracefully: without the plugin the Markdown shows the images one after another.
problem: Obsidian shows embedded images one after another with no way to caption them or arrange them in figures, rows or grids.
summary: Renders image embeds as captioned figures, side-by-side rows, gallery grids and image-beside-text asides in reading view and Live Preview.
